decisions.decision: Two things are left, and Claude decides both. M033: cut the free-lane intake to the paid lane's 11 questions, reusing the same question set in success-client.tsx. Keep any field the centre or the intake reads, and keep the survey before the community step. O013: the join pages already get the attendee's private feed through usePersonalFeed (stashed registrant → issueFeed). Use that same feed token to give the join button the attendee's own Zoom registrant join_url for today's or the next session. Read it from the Worker, for example a small JSON twin of /cal/p/<token>, or by parsing the .ics. Keep the 'your link comes by email' state as the fallback. Check /workshop/join and /masterclass/success/join with headless Chromium and the cohort probes, run tsc and probe-funnels.mjs, then commit. Mark M033 and O013 fixed in AUDIT.md with the commit, and move T-278 to review for Adi and Bharath.
decisions.why: Adi's 2026-10-09 autonomy rule makes M033 Claude's call; shortening was already the recommendation and cuts drop-off. The 2026-10-06 calendar-feeds handoff shows the join pages already hold a per-attendee feed token, so O013 can be done.

decisions.decision:
Finish the three leftovers, then return T-278 to review.
1) Push: run tsc, probe-cohort and probe-funnels on main, then push main to our private repo. A private push publishes nothing, and Adi's rule is that main holds the latest.
2) Deploy the centre Worker with wrangler so /cal/p/<token>.json is live. First confirm cloud/ on main passes its probes and has no unapplied migration. If another lane's cloud change fails, deploy from a branch holding only a8e393a's cloud changes.
3) Add the attendee's ?f=<feed token> join link to the confirmation and reminder email templates and the calendar invite description. Change templates only; do not send to real attendees.
4) Republish the mirror. Check both join pages on the hosted stack in all 3 states, and post cache-busted review links for each state.
5) M033 stays at 11 questions. Note on T-093 that its 'keep 18' is superseded.
